criteria.statement: `packages/core/commands/plan.md` has a sub-step 2e.1 placed directly after 2e's grounding and before any task-writing step (2f onward)
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 8-9 ("a new sub-step **2e.1**, directly after 2e's grounding")
criteria.evidence: `grep -nE '2e\b\|2e\.1\|2f' packages/core/commands/plan.md` output showing the 2e heading, then 2e.1, then 2f, in that line order

criteria.statement: A `/plan` run states the change's size as `size: <n> files touched` before any task is written, and the prompt's 2e.1 instructs it
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 8-9 ("states `size: <n> files touched` before any task is written"); line 2-3 (before: "no size statement")
criteria.evidence: Transcript of a headless `/plan` session in a fixture repo, showing the `files touched` line ahead of the first written task (and ahead of the TRD's task list); plus `grep -n 'files touched' packages/core/commands/plan.md`

criteria.statement: When the base branch's `git log` over the touched files shows a recent predecessor, `/plan` lists what that predecessor `already provides`
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 10-11 ("finds a recent predecessor with `git log` on the base branch over the touched files, lists what it `already provides`")
criteria.evidence: Transcript of a fixture `/plan` run in a repo whose base branch carries a just-merged commit over the files the described change touches, showing an `already provides` list naming that commit's contribution

criteria.statement: In that same predecessor case, each planned task that rebuilds or re-tests what the predecessor provides is flagged as such
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 11-12 ("flags tasks that rebuild or re-test it")
criteria.evidence: The FS-3 transcript (or the TRD it wrote), with a flag line attached to the task that duplicates the predecessor's work, the task named

criteria.statement: When no recent predecessor is found on the base branch over the touched files, no task is flagged as rebuilding or re-testing one
criteria.cites: domain-derived: the flag in lines 11-12 is conditional on a predecessor being found; a delta step that flags tasks with no predecessor would invent duplicated work and push the plan to cut real tasks
criteria.evidence: Transcript of a fixture `/plan` run in a repo with no recent commit over the touched files, showing the predecessor search came back empty and no rebuild/re-test flag appears

criteria.statement: When the description's own acceptance criteria ask for machinery beyond the change, `/plan` writes one `the description asks for <X> beyond the change; kept / cut` line per such item, holding the description to 2f's suspicion
criteria.cites: §Intended Change lines 12-13 ("holds the description's own criteria to 2f's suspicion, writing one `the description asks for <X> beyond the change; kept / cut` line per item"); lines 4-5 (before: 2f "names blockers and audit findings, not the description")
criteria.evidence: Transcript of a fixture `/plan` run whose description carries criteria well beyond its small change, showing one `beyond the change;` line per inflated item, each ending `kept` or `cut`

criteria.statement: A description criterion that is must-pass is never cut by that step: its line reads `kept`, and the prompt says so
criteria.cites: §Intended Change line 13 ("never cutting a must-pass criterion")
criteria.evidence: `grep -n -i 'must-pass' packages/core/commands/plan.md` showing the never-cut rule inside 2e.1; where the FS-6 run's description marks a criterion must-pass, its `beyond the change` line ending `kept`

criteria.statement: Step 4 of `plan.md` carries a paragraph telling the planner to weigh the §2e.1 size and delta, not the description's list
criteria.cites: §Intended Change line 14 ("Step 4 gains a paragraph: weigh the §2e.1 size and delta, not the description's list"); line 3-4 (before: "Step 4 weighs from the investigation alone")
criteria.evidence: The Step 4 section of `packages/core/commands/plan.md`, quoted, containing a reference to `2e.1` and the instruction not to weigh from the description's list

criteria.statement: The Readout section of `plan.md` says DECISIONS carries the `kept / cut` lines, and a run's readout DECISIONS section shows them, recording the decision
criteria.cites: §Intended Change line 15 ("the Readout section says DECISIONS carries those lines")
criteria.evidence: `grep -n` of the Readout section of `packages/core/commands/plan.md` naming DECISIONS and the `beyond the change` lines; plus the FS-6 run's closing readout with the line under its DECISIONS heading
